media.title: The Goat Herd
media.content:
The Goat Herd

Young Peter was given the responsibility of herding his father's five goats after school. Every afternoon, he led them up the rocky hill where the sweet shrubs grew. He carried a small stick to guide them and kept a sharp eye out for straying animals. While the goats grazed happily, Peter sat on a flat rock and practiced writing spelling words in the dirt. He knew that taking care of the animals was his first step toward learning responsibility.

questions.text: What does Peter do while the goats are grazing?
options: He plays football with other village boys
He practices writing spelling words in the dirt
He goes to sleep under a big umbrella
questions.answer: He practices writing spelling words in the dirt
